type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (M : AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Model N) (hDVR : AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.PlacesDiscrete M)
  (ψ : ↥M.K),
  Transcendental ℚ ψ →
    ∀ (x : AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.QbarPoint ↥M.K)
      (h : AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.NoncriticalP1.ElemMap),
      Transcendental ℚ (AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.NoncriticalP1.applyK h ψ) ∧
        AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.noncriticalValue M x
              (AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.NoncriticalP1.applyK h ψ) =
            h.apply (AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.noncriticalValue M x ψ) ∧
          AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.ramIdx M hDVR (AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.NoncriticalP1.applyK h ψ)
              x.P =
            AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.ramIdx M hDVR ψ x.P *
              ↑(h.ramIdx (AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.noncriticalValue M x ψ))
name: AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.noncriticalElementaryCompositionRamification
